title: Weapon Enchantment
body:
Syntax: weapon enchantment <weapon> <flaming|frost|life|sharp|vorpal|shocking>
       weapon enchantment <chakra steel weapon> <fire|water|wind|lightning|earth>

Description: A Bukijutsu shinobi of level 55+ can permanently infuse ANY weapon type (Sword, Kunai, Shuriken, Blunt, Polearm, or Exotic) that was genuinely forged using a Chakra Steel Ingot. An item's real crafting materials, not its custom name, are checked. The Bukijutsu user must possess the chosen revealed chakra nature. The elemental enchantment persists on the individual weapon through trades, saves and reboots. A Bukijutsu WIELDER with the SAME unlocked chakra nature gains +50% weapon-strike damage. This stacks multiplicatively with Samurai Sabre's +20% for swords (together +80%); Earth adds a further +25% raw damage. Successful hits reuse the matching elemental jutsu's effect and chance: Fire Burning (40%), Water Drained chakra (40%), Wind Off Balance/stamina drain (40%), Lightning Paralyzed (30%), Earth extra direct damage (no status). Only swords can activate Samurai Sabre; other weapon types still gain the elemental enchantment. Non-Bukijutsu wielders and Bukijutsu wielders without the matched nature gain no elemental boost or status. Disenchant to replace the existing one-per-weapon enchantment. Costs 60 Chakra and 20 Stamina; 10-second cooldown.

Level gained: 55
Damage type: Elemental weapon strikes (Fire / Water / Wind / Lightning / Earth)
Base damage: +50% weapon strike (+25% more on Earth), stacks with Samurai Sabre on swords
